quantity.name: concentration profile, with scalar reference at x = 0.25 m and t = 0.1 s

reference.source: Finite slab initially at c0 with c(0,t)=c(L,t)=0: c/c0 = (4/pi) sum_{n odd} [exp(-D n^2 pi^2 t/L^2) sin(n pi x/L)/n]. No-flux check uses c = cbar + A exp(-D pi^2 t/L^2) cos(pi x/L).
reference.confirmed_from: Series summed to n=1999 and the Neumann cosine mode evaluated independently with numpy.

tolerance.metric: maximum normalized L2 concentration-profile error over t = 0.025, 0.05, and 0.1 s
tolerance.rationale: The 0.2% profile tolerance allows finite-element and time-discretization error while remaining well below visual agreement; no-flux mass conservation has a separate solver-tolerance criterion of 1e-10 relative.
